name: @pipeworx/mcp-disify

tools.name: validate_email
tools.description: Verify an email address is properly formatted, has valid DNS records, and isn't disposable or an alias. Returns validation status, a 0-100 confidence score and the signals behind it. Pass your own Disify key as _apiKey — the keyless anonymous quota is shared and usually spent.

_apiKey.description: Optional but recommended: your own Disify API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Without it the call uses the anonymous tier, whose daily quota is shared across all Pipeworx callers and is usually exhausted. Get one at disify.com.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check if a domain is associated with disposable or temporary email services. Returns risk assessment, a 0-100 confidence score and the signals behind it. Pass your own Disify key as _apiKey — the keyless anonymous quota is shared and usually spent.

domain.description: The domain name to check, e.g. "mailinator.com".

_apiKey.description: Optional but recommended: your own Disify API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Without it the call uses the anonymous tier, whose daily quota is shared across all Pipeworx callers and is usually exhausted. Get one at disify.com.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-disify forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the disify pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
